title: Traverse selected engineering relationships
description: Return entities and typed paths reachable from selected starting entities under explicit relationship and direction choices. The result describes connectivity and its limits; impact judgment is a separate behavior.
inputs: Selected project model state and starting entity references.
Requested relationship types, traversal direction, and any explicit depth or result limits.
outputs: Reachable entities and supporting typed paths with the exact selected scope.
Completion within requested scope, explicit limitation, or incomplete outcome with reasons.
behavior: Validate the model-state selection, starting references, relationship types, direction, and requested limits.
Follow authoritative and derived inverse relationships according to the requested scope.
Include all reachable entities within that scope when no limitation interrupts exploration.
Terminate cross-domain cycles without repeatedly processing the same traversal state.
Distinguish fully explored requested boundaries from incomplete results and from unrestricted reachability.

failure_behavior.condition: The start, type, direction, or selected state is unresolved or unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return an actionable scope diagnostic without silently substituting a different selection.

failure_behavior.condition: A traversed reference is missing or ambiguous.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the affected path and incomplete scope, retaining usable observations as partial.

failure_behavior.condition: An interruption or resource limit prevents completion.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return explicit incomplete status and the known limit; never report unqualified empty or complete reachability.

sources.basis: IR-002 / SR-009 confirms scoped traversal; SR-008, SR-010, and SR-011 constrain its fact consistency and downstream interpretation.

Propose MOD-004 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
